question: What exactly is reference [17] of the YOPO paper, and is its implementation obtainable?

source_document.extraction: PyMuPDF text extraction; reference list located by the literal marker '[17]'

reference_17_verbatim: [17] H. Lu, Q. Zong, S. Lai, B. Tian, and L. Xie, “Flight with limited field of view: A parallel and gradient-free strategy for micro aerial vehicle,” IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, vol. 69, no. 9, pp. 9258–9267, 2021.

paper_claims: Gradient-free method MPPI (Model Predictive Path Integration) solves the planning problem using forward sampling of a stochastic diffusion process.
MPPI Planner significantly reduces the mapping delay by implementing parallel on GPU, and performs back-end optimization with a Monte Carlo approximation using forward sampling.
Safety of TopoTraj with multiple topological guiding paths is superior to MPPI with a single Hybrid A* as the front end.
Baselines were fine-tuned for better real-time and safety performance trade-offs in the evaluation environment.

known_related_but_distinct.why_not_substituted: RAPA-Planner is a later, different method (parallel RA-MPPI) from a different group; the project explicitly forbids substituting it for reference [17].
Recent third-party hybrid-A*-guided MPPI; not the 2021 TIE baseline.
